title: pi-codex-minimal-tools configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-codex-minimal-tools Pi extension.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

enabled.description: Register this package's tools and provider shim.

glyphStyle.description: Glyph style used by the extension UI.

autoEnable.description: Automatically activate enabled package tools on supported models.

nativeProviderTools.description: Rewrite hosted-tool placeholders into native OpenAI Responses tools on openai and openai-codex.

compactionMode.description: Compaction implementation for GPT-5-series models on the openai provider. pi uses Pi summaries; responses-context-management uses /responses context_management; responses-compact uses /responses/compact.

nativeCompactionThreshold.description: Token threshold for responses-context-management. Set to 0 to derive a threshold below Pi's default auto-compaction boundary.

requestProfile.description: Explicit overrides for the OpenAI Responses request profile.

responsesMode.description: Responses protocol mode. Lite requires an endpoint that implements the Codex Responses Lite contract.

systemPromptPlacement.description: Where Standard Responses places Pi's system prompt. Responses Lite always uses a developer message.

patchTransport.description: Transport for apply_patch: a JSON function tool or the Codex freeform custom tool.

supportsHostedTools.description: Enable hosted-tool activation and request rewriting. Responses Lite always disables hosted tools.

supportsParallelTools.description: Enable parallel tool calls in provider requests. Responses Lite always disables parallel tools.

apiKeyMode.description: Use plain Bearer API-key authentication for openai-codex instead of ChatGPT account headers. The openai provider always uses API-key transport.

imageGeneration.description: Expose image_generation on supported OpenAI Codex models.

webSearchEnabled.description: Expose hosted web_search on GPT-5-series openai and openai-codex models.

imageOutputDir.description: Directory for generated images. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

imageModel.description: Image model used for native or fallback image generation.

directImageApiFallback.description: Allow direct OpenAI Images API generation when native Codex generation is unavailable.

viewImage.description: Expose the view_image tool on image-capable models.

viewImageWorkspaceOnly.description: Reject view_image paths outside the active workspace.

applyPatchEnabled.description: Expose apply_patch only on GPT-5-series models from the openai provider.

allowAbsolutePatchPaths.description: Allow absolute paths in apply_patch. Relative path escapes remain blocked.

deferApplyPatchRendering.description: Use Pi's fallback tool renderer instead of the built-in streaming filesystem preview.
